items.q: What is the difference between Java and JavaScript?
items.a: Java and JavaScript are two distinct programming languages. Java is an object-oriented language used for Android app development, web development, and more, while JavaScript is a scripting language used for client-side scripting on the web.

items.q: How do I learn Java?
items.a: You can learn Java by taking online courses, reading books, or practicing coding on platforms like LeetCode, HackerRank, or CodeWars.

blocks.q: What is the output of the following Java code: System.out.println(10 + 20);
blocks.explain: The output is 30 because the + operator is used for addition.

items.q: What is the purpose of the finally block in Java?
